618152f74a88: How much does a travel agency website cost with Travelife?
53804ec2b4cb: Travelife offers three published plans. The Travelife Starter plan costs 99 € per month plus a 500 € setup fee: it suits agencies selling their own products (tours, direct hotel contracts, activities). The Travelife Advanced plan costs 399 € per month plus a 1,500 € setup fee, and includes 2 APIs (1 hotel feed, 1 flight feed), the Packages module and 6 to 8 hours of training. The Premium / Enterprise plan is quote-based. Travelife takes no commission on sales made through your website. Full details are on the B2C website pricing page.
f2a54476f0f6: How quickly can my travel agency website go live?
47550e8ad97b: Allow about 2 weeks. Travelife is a turnkey solution designed specifically for travel agencies and tour operators: you don't need to write specifications or explain the travel business to a generalist provider. Our teams set up your domain, integrate your logo and brand guidelines, then train you on the tool. The website comes with all the features needed to manage your offers, bookings and customers, and you can then add your trips and tours at your own pace from the back office.
54c1541e90c5: Do I need WordPress or technical skills to manage my travel agency website?
7809da904c0c: No. The Travelife website is managed without an external CMS like WordPress and without technical skills. The Theme Builder lets you choose the theme and change the colors, menu and footer with real-time preview. The Menu Builder organizes navigation, and the Page Builder builds each page by adding modules: trips, search engines, forms or marketing content. The trips, tours, photos and articles you enter are formatted automatically. Built-in SEO tools let you set the title and description of each page.
04163db4b99c: Which plan should I choose for my agency website: Starter, Advanced or Premium?
2a23160e2e35: It depends on your business model. Travelife Starter is ideal for local experts and inbound agencies that showcase their own products without relying on external APIs. Travelife Advanced is for outbound agencies and OTAs that want to connect their suppliers and automate sales with flight and hotel API feeds. Premium / Enterprise is designed for large networks and tour operators: unlimited access to the API Hub (Amadeus GDS, Sabre GDS, Travelgate, multiple wholesalers), dedicated servers and 24/7 priority support. You can upgrade from one plan to another.
f959781b8ec2: Can my travel agency website be funded by GO SIYAHA?
56c775bd5810: Yes, for eligible agencies in Morocco. Travelife is listed with Maroc PME under the GO SIYAHA program, dedicated to the digital transformation of travel agencies. This program can fund up to 90% of solutions such as the B2C website, the travel agency management software, the B2B booking platform or sales automation. To check your eligibility and learn about the process, contact us at (+212) 5 21 50 06 05 or contact@travelife.ma.
